title: AI Assistant for Internship/New Grad Job Finder
summary: HireWizard matches internship and new-grad job seekers to roles by analyzing resumes against job postings.
description: HireWizard is an AI-driven job search assistant that matches job seekers to relevant roles based on resume analysis and job posting data.
built: It uses NLP-powered resume screening, cosine similarity for job matching, and integrates with job databases like LinkedIn and Indeed to improve hiring outcomes.
